## Checklist

Tick what applies; leave the rest.

- [ ] Relevant to FM/AR software development
- [ ] Scope and limitations are stated accurately
- [ ] **Local skill:** complete package under `skills/<id>/` (`SKILL.md`, `LICENSE.txt`, required resources, setup)
- [ ] **External skill:** exact package link, license link or `unknown`, revision examined if known
- [ ] License and provenance (`PROVENANCE.md` for adapted material) are correct
- [ ] No hidden side effects (installs, network use, credentials, expensive runs are marked)
- [ ] `python tools/catalog.py validate` and `python tools/catalog.py render --check` pass
- [ ] Any review or evidence record links to a real source that supports it
